name: approvals_of_a_run_the_tool_opened
why: The tool opened the run, so no server served its approvals.

name: commit_review_of_a_run_the_tool_opened
why: The tool opened the run, so no server served its commit review.

name: approvals_of_a_run_the_tool_opened_whose_pre_deploy_stage_is_pending
why: run_opened_locally comes before pre_deploy_pending: no server will ever serve approvals to this run.

name: approvals_of_a_run_the_tool_opened_whose_stage_read_none
why: run_opened_locally comes before the stage's own result, here the marker that it read no approvals.

name: approvals_a_server_opened_run_needed_and_did_not_get
why: The server opened the run and the pre-deploy stage kept the unknown marker where a check needed its approvals.

name: exceptions_of_a_run_that_relied_on_a_project_exception
why: An event names an exception from the project's own exceptions file; it comes before run_opened_locally and pre_deploy_pending.

name: exceptions_of_a_server_opened_run_that_lists_none
why: The server opened the run and the record lists no exception, so a verifier cannot assess any the server may have served.

name: reference_time_of_a_run_on_the_runners_clock
why: Every stage took its time from the runner's clock, so no trusted time source was used.

name: reference_time_of_a_run_on_the_servers_time
why: Every stage took the time the server gave, the record's own claim.

name: evaluator_binary_of_a_record_on_a_placeholder_binary
why: Its OPA evaluations name a placeholder digest, not the pinned binary for their platform.

name: evaluator_binary_of_a_record_on_the_pinned_binary
why: Every OPA evaluation names the pinned binary for its platform.

name: exceptions_of_a_run_that_relied_on_a_project_exception_with_its_pre_deploy_stage_out_of_scope
why: The plan stage relied on an exception from the project's own exceptions file; it comes before pre_deploy_out_of_scope, which would otherwise hide it.
